structured.approach: I followed the FE-05 procedure in the frontend-steps skill and read task.code and feat.stories. Before relying on the code, I read the exact source of renderOverdueRisk and its helpers, and their blast radius, with the codegraph MCP tool. I added node:test cases to tests/portal.test.js after the existing tests, which I did not change. There is one test for each of AC-07.1 to AC-07.10, plus the TypeError coverage cases that task.code section 6 hands over. All test data is synthetic SYN-INV data. I ran `node ci.mjs` from the repository root and it exited 0, which means passed. I then ran `codegraph sync` and `codegraph affected` to confirm which test file the change touches. Last, I wrote task.unit_tests with a table that traces each test to its acceptance criterion.

claims.text: Before FE-05, CI reported coverage 60.32, and lines 26-28 33-39 42-44 50-61 of src/ap_portal/index.js were uncovered because no test called the new functions.
The step requires unit tests that cover the new code with at least 90 percent coverage. node ci.mjs ends with passed true only when coverage >= 90, all tests pass and there are no static issues.
tests/portal.test.js keeps the existing tests 'formats amounts with two decimals' and 'renders every bucket in order' unchanged, and adds tests named AC-07.1 to AC-07.10 for renderOverdueRisk.
escapeHtml, toTwoDecimalString and riskClass each have 1 caller, inside src/ap_portal/index.js, and they are reached only through the exported renderOverdueRisk.

The amount tests check that two-decimal strings, including one longer than a JS Number can hold, are shown unchanged, and that '980.5' renders as '980.50'. This follows decision D-2026-044 (Decimal, never float).

Tests assert the exact TypeError messages for a non-array rows value, a non-integer days value and an amount that is not a decimal string with at most two decimals. These are the coverage cases handed over in task.code section 6.
Rows are rendered in the given order (SYN-INV-002 before SYN-INV-001), and an unexpected risk value such as 'critical' renders as risk-unknown.

open_questions: Q-1 (non-blocking, Developer): feat.design B4.5 and the TRD tests T-12 to T-16 are not inputs of FE-05, so the tests are traced only to AC-07.1 to AC-07.10. Should they also be checked against B4.5?
Q-2 (non-blocking, Developer; carried from task.code Q-1): which step sets the next minor version in both index.js and package.json (TK-07.5) before FE-06?
Q-3 (non-blocking, Architect; carried from task.code Q-2): should a missing or non-string id or vendor throw TypeError? No test pins the current String(value) behaviour.
structured.summary: The STORY-07 unit tests are added to tests/portal.test.js. They cover AC-07.1 to AC-07.10 of renderOverdueRisk and the TypeError paths for rows, days and amount, using synthetic data only. `node ci.mjs` passes (exit 0), and the coverage report shows src/ap_portal/index.js fully covered, above the 90% gate. task.unit_tests records the tests, the trace from each test to its criterion, the CI result and the open questions. Nothing is committed.
